Rich, deeply savory, and melt-in-your-mouth succulent, each piece is simmered low and slow in a bold blend of Caribbean aromatics and island spices until the meat practically dissolves into its own luxurious sauce. Served over fluffy jollof rice with seasoned cabbage — this is the dish guests rave about most. One bite and you'll understand why
